title: Named concrete pure Kummer normalization proposition
statement: Fix a prime ell, a scheme W on which ell is invertible, derived categories for the integral sheaves and strict p-adic systems, the canonical Ext structures [lem-sfb-canonical-sheaf-ext], a derived reduction D and evaluated units eta [lem-sfb-diagonal-evaluation-unit]. The proposition strictKummerPureKernelNormalizationStatement is exactly the specialization of KummerPureKernelNormalization [lem-sfb-kummer-normalization-from-triangles] to the scalar extension, forgetting functors and finite coefficient categories [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface], actual roots tower [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf], finite Tate lines [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface] and compared Kummer class and root normalization [def-sfb-kummer-strict-adjunct-data]. The real record strictKummerNormalizationCoefficients contains exactly the former explicit coefficient parameters. Expanding its fields and the Normalized definition gives the former displayed conclusion of strict_kummer_pure_kernel_normalization by definitional equality. No data is chosen from a theorem.
